understood_as: Source-only third-system audit and explicitly provisional music-only expansion. Retain frozen first two systems and owner evidence. New chords, lyrics, lyric associations and disputed SIG attachments remain review candidates, not rendered as confirmed content.
target_reference_policy: Do not load A/G reference page rasters or reference recognition. GT02 Bb rows only; legacy cross-page coordinate metadata is ignored.
font_policy: Reuse frozen FreeSerif and GT05 fixed-phase glyph placement. U+1D157 VOID NOTEHEAD for duration 2; U+1D13C HALF REST for duration 2; same notehead-derived font scale. Synthetic anchors and transparent-hole controls must pass before score rendering.
beam_policy: Only explicit single-level upward eighth-note beams with exactly 2 or 4 SIG-connected stems and semantic start/continue/stop sequence. Preserve source slope/thickness; re-anchor using existing min(y-3.5*interline-slope*dx) rule. Do not modify historical beam helpers or broaden their gates.
flag_policy: Reuse GT07 upward FLAG_1 glyph and fixed-phase stem-tip attachment; explicit head-stem and flag-stem required, positive actual contacts and no head/flag overlap.
stem_policy: Reuse right-edge occupied-column head attachment. Non-beamed length max(3.5*interline, source head-center minus source stem top). Stem direction must be upward and RIGHT head-stem lineage explicit.
tie_policy: Reuse GT14 local_tie and 65-sample width-2 curve mask, same-pitch source-supported START/STOP endpoints, attachment residual <=0.5. New local/adjacent-measure ties are OMR_PROVISIONAL.
ending_policy: Source second-ending bracket 5193 and serialized RepeatBracket 2 span m9 only; render source-supported open-right bracket/numeral as provisional. First-ending m8 and backward repeat remain frozen owner-confirmed. Do not expand playback or invent new repeats.
new_text_policy: Review-only agent candidates: m10 Eb, m12 F, 20 visible Korean syllables and 11 visible continuation strokes. Sparse/mixed OMR lyric observations preserved; no new chords or lyrics rendered before source confirmation.
collision_policy: All nonzero alpha pixels count; only same-event head/stem/ledger/flag and explicitly connected beam-stem contacts intentional. Report any unexpected contacts, missing connections or clipping without retuning. Staff crossings intentional. No new lyric/music zero-contact claim when lyrics are withheld.
review_policy: Original native raster only, all new owner responses null. Agent candidates and OMR_PROVISIONAL are distinct from OWNER_VERIFIED_SOURCE. No independent human labels fabricated.
preservation: Keep all historical output files unchanged; integrated first-two-system viewport must equal GT14E at every pixel. New third-system ink must not enter page y<1030.
stopping: Freeze prediction hashes before agent visual review. Do not correct source recognition or retune after preview. Report incomplete source, disputed attachments and omitted text explicitly.
